Wait, so Jokshan's father is Abraham. After Sarah died, Abraham married Hagar, who is sometimes referred to as Keturah. They had children together, including Jokshan. So the answer should be Hagar, also known as Keturah.

I think the confusion might come from the fact that Hagar and Keturah are used interchangeably, but technically, Hagar is the name given in Genesis, and Keturah is another name used in some commentaries.
